top_catalog_fingerprints: SELECT c.column_name, c.data_type, CASE WHEN c.nullable = '?' THEN '?' ELSE '?' END AS nullable_flag, c.data_default, c.data_length, c.data_precision, c.data_sc
SELECT idx.index_name, idx.uniqueness, idx.index_type, col.column_name, col.column_position FROM all_indexes idx JOIN all_ind_columns col ON idx.index_name = co
SELECT cols.column_name FROM all_constraints cons, all_cons_columns cols WHERE cons.constraint_type = '?' AND cons.constraint_name = cols.constraint_name AND co
SELECT fk.constraint_name AS foreign_key_name, fk.column_name AS child_column_name, pk.table_name AS parent_table_name, pk.column_name AS parent_column_name FRO
SELECT a.constraint_name, a.column_name FROM all_cons_columns a JOIN all_constraints c ON a.owner = c.owner AND a.constraint_name = c.constraint_name WHERE c.co
SELECT t.table_name, c.comments AS table_comment FROM all_tables t LEFT JOIN all_tab_comments c ON t.owner = c.owner AND t.table_name = c.table_name WHERE t.own
SELECT v.view_name AS table_name, c.comments AS table_comment FROM all_views v LEFT JOIN all_mview_comments c ON v.owner = c.owner AND v.view_name = c.mview_nam
SELECT CASE WHEN p.object_type = '?' AND p.procedure_name IS NOT NULL THEN p.object_name || '?' || p.procedure_name || CASE WHEN p.overload IS NOT NULL THEN '?'
